H4.interval: features only: the pooled fingerprint cannot be resampled by source-sentence cluster

population: Gemma-2-2B, layer-12 Gemma Scope 16k SAE, RTN per-output-channel; INT16 is the rounding reference
rules: CLAIM_RULES of phase1_transfer_report.py (fixed 2026-10-26 before any full-run output; tightened the same day after an independent review, before any outcome was read: amendment A14)

scope.feature_bootstrap: features and source-sentence clusters crossed (2,000 replicates); the pooled quantities of H4: features only
scope.group_bootstrap: source sentences only (the groups and the matched control draws are fixed)
scope.held_out: feature-held-out: the held-out half are other FEATURES; their contexts share source sentences with the calibration half (no document holdout), so sentence-level covariates can carry sentence-specific signal
scope.specificity: the control directions are not eligibility-filtered and have a small full-precision effect, so their normalized error is dominated by the floor: the real-minus-control gap mixes scale and specificity
